Job Description -

Strong understanding of agentic AI fundamentals goal definition, planning, reasoning, task decomposition, and autonomous action loops.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate AI Engineer to design and build enterprise-grade, production-ready conversational and agentic AI systems that enhance how users interact with enterprise products, services, insights, and recommendations.
This role goes beyond traditional chatbots. You will architect and deliver multi-agent, tool-augmented GenAI solutions capable of reasoning, planning, contextual retrieval, and action execution across multiple enterprise data sources and platforms. You will work on secure, scalable, and governed GenAI systems , aligned with enterprise architecture and compliance standards, ensuring reliability, explainability, observability, and continuous improvement in real-world production environments .


Responsibilities

GenAI Agentic System Development

Design, develop, and deploy production-grade GenAI solutions using advanced LLMs (OpenAI APIs such as GPT-4.1, GPT-4o, etc.).
Build agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and Haystack, including: multi-agent orchestration (planner, retriever, evaluator, executor agents); tool-calling, function execution, and system-to-system automation; memory management (short-term, long-term, and session-based).
Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using structured and unstructured enterprise data.
Design hybrid search architectures combining Vector DBs and Graph DBs (e.g., Azure AI Search, Neo4j) for semantic, contextual, and relationship-based retrieval.


Enterprise Integration Cloud Engineering

Develop and integrate AI-powered chatbots and agents within the Azure ecosystem, ensuring seamless interoperability with existing platforms and services.
Integrate GenAI solutions with enterprise systems using APIs, event-driven architectures, and message brokers.
Build secure, scalable backends leveraging Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Bot Framework, Azure Cache for Redis, and related services.
Work closely with Cloud, Digital, Data Engineering, and Business teams to drive adoption and real-world impact.


Production Readiness, MLOps LLMOps

Apply MLOps / LLMOps best practices across the lifecycle: model/version management and prompt versioning; CI/CD pipelines for GenAI applications; automated testing (prompt, retrieval, and regression testing); monitoring, logging, and observability for LLM outputs.
Implement guardrails for safety, hallucination control, data privacy, and responsible AI.
Ensure enterprise-grade governance, including access control, auditability, and compliance with internal policies.


Performance Optimization and Continuous Improvement

Analyze chatbot and agent performance using quantitative and qualitative metrics (accuracy, latency, adoption, task completion).
Optimize prompts, retrieval strategies, agent flows, and system performance based on real usage data.
Drive continuous enhancement of user experience through experimentation and feedback loops.


Requirements

Strong understanding of LLMs, transformers, embeddings, prompt engineering, and evaluation techniques.
Experience building end-to-end GenAI/Agentic AI products, including backend services and frontend web apps.
Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, n8n, Co-pilot for building modular, agent-based systems.
Practical experience designing multi-agent architectures and orchestrating reasoning and action workflows.
Strong experience with Vector Databases and Graph Databases (Azure AI Search, Neo4j, Databricks Vector DB) for hybrid, semantic and relationship-driven search.
Proven experience implementing RAG pipelines with structured and unstructured enterprise data.
Proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, and familiarity with additional languages (e.g., JavaScript).
Hands-on experience with PyTorch and TensorFlow.
Experience working with high-performance, large-scale ML systems in production environments.
Ability to solve complex problems in language understanding, reasoning, and GenAI system design.
Experience deploying GenAI solutions on Azure, including: Azure Data Factory (ADF); Databricks; Azure AI Search; Databricks Genie; AI Document Intelligence; App Services, Azure Functions, Bot Framework; Azure Cache for Redis.

About the Role




Were building a next-generation AI-powered platform for financial advisors. This isn't theory. Were solving real-world problems with real-world data and we need an experienced AI/ML Engineer who knows how to build, deploy, and scale machine learning systems that actually ship. You will own AI systems end-to-end from problem framing and architecture design to deployment, monitoring, and optimization. This role requires someone who can independently drive initiatives, make sound architectural decisions, and improve the reliability and scalability of our ML infrastructure. From financial plan generation to LLM-powered automation and personalized insights, this role requires someone who understands both the tech and the business need behind it.




You



Move fast, think clearly, and adapt without friction
Love testing ideas, building prototypes, and iterating based on real user data
Prefer action over meetings and always look for a better way to do things
Want to be part of a product that redefines an entire industry
Have technical understanding of how things work
Clear and concise communication, collaborator, and coder
Be a doer rather than a talker, going plus ultra



What You'll Do

Design and deploy ML pipelines for automated financial plan creation, personalized advisor recommendation, and create actionable insights tailored to client behavior
Architect scalable ML and LLM systems capable of handling high-volume financial data
Build LLM-powered workflows using: Python, Linux, Kubernetes, AWS boto3, Strands agent, Agent squad, dspy, mlflow, fastAPI, websockets, caching, bert, hugging face, notebooks, kafka and system design is a plus
Work with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, AWS specific, etc.) to support RAG pipelines
Turn ML models into secure, production-ready features via APIs
Tune, monitor, and retrain models based on usage and behavior
Make sure outputs are explainable and in line with compliance and data privacy standards
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to move from prototype to live feature quickly
Conduct technical reviews of ML architecture and code
Drive experimentation roadmap and hypothesis testing strategy



What We Expect From You



3-5 years of hands-on experience building and deploying production ML systems
Strong coding skills in Python, Linux, VCS, Database
Strong understanding of distributed systems and production infrastructure
Experience designing end-to-end ML architectures (data ingestion training serving monitoring)
Experience optimizing model performance and cost efficiency in cloud environments
Deep understanding of LLM tradeoffs (fine-tuning vs RAG vs hybrid approaches)
Experience implementing evaluation frameworks for LLM reliability and safety
Familiarity with model governance and auditability in regulated industries
Experience scaling ML systems under real user load
Demonstrated ability to independently lead ML initiatives from concept to launch
Experience with ML libraries like PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Sentence Transformers, Transformers, Streamlit etc.
Direct, hands-on experience with LLMs not just playing with prompts, but integrating them into production workflows
Familiar with AutoGen, LangChain or similar orchestration tools
Comfortable using embeddings and vector databases for search or memory
Clear communicator who can explain what the model does and why it matters to both technical and non-technical teams
Experience working in fast-paced, early-stage SaaS or startup teams



Preferred (Not Required)




Experience building AI systems in regulated industries (fintech, banking, wealth management)
Experience working with structured and unstructured financial datasets (transactions, portfolio data, CRM data, planning data)
Familiarity with financial planning concepts (AUM models, retirement projections, tax optimization, risk profiling)
Familiarity with SOC 2, GDPR, SEC/FINRA considerations, or financial auditability standards
Experience building systems with data lineage and model audit tracking



Must-Haves (Non-Negotiable)




1. You must be currently based in India.

2. You must be available to work during U.S. Mountain Standard Time hours (India night shift).

3. You should be looking for a long-term, full-time opportunity with ownership, not a freelance or short-term contract.




Why This Role?




You wont just be a cog in the system. You'll own a core part of the product, help shape the tech direction, and work directly with founders who value execution over theory. You'll help build something that moves fast, solves problems at scale, and redefines how financial advice is delivered.




Apply only if you're serious, qualified, and ready to deliver.




Were not hiring resumes. Were hiring builders.

Job Summary

About Tristone Strategic Partners LLP- Tristone Strategic Partners is a financial services firm based in Mumbai that provides investments and accounting-related support services and advisory services to international clients such as various investment funds, hedge funds, wealth management firms, start-ups corporates located across different geographies.

About the role- Tristone is embedding agentic AI directly into its workflows and systems. As a member of the Agentic AI engineering team, you'll help build agents, MCP servers, and evaluation loops that make AI generated code reliable, auditable, and fast to ship. You'll work closely with senior members of Tristone to deliver pragmatic, high-impact AI integrations at scale.

Key Responsibilities
Designing, building, and deploying AI-powered tools, agents, and workflow automations for use across the firm.
Working hands-on with the Claude ecosystem - Cowork, Claude Code, Connectors, Skills, and Plugins - alongside other AI platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, and others).
Owning the end-to-end deployment lifecycle for AI tools and agents, including packaging, testing, hosting, and monitoring in production.
Collaborating with teams across the firm to identify opportunities to automate repetitive or manual processes using AI and workflow orchestration tools.
Reviewing and validating AI-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, completeness, and reliability before they reach internal or client-facing use.
Staying current on evolving AI capabilities and evaluating new tools and platforms for potential adoption.
Documenting technical approaches clearly and communicating outcomes to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Exercising sound judgement across AI workflows: assessing which client and fund data may be sent to which model, working exclusively through approved endpoints and enterprise tooling, and upholding the confidentiality obligations expected in a financial services environment.
Complying with IT policies and procedures.
Maintaining the security of information at all times.
Requirements
AI Tools LLMs - Hands-on experience using platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Copilot, with the prompt-engineering skill to get consistent, high-quality outputs across models.
Agents and MCP - Hands-on experience building agentic workflows and integrating external tools through MCP servers or equivalent tool-use frameworks. Alongside this, a systematic approach to validating model output: maintained eval sets, regression checks before release, and structured human review loops, rather than ad-hoc spot checking.
Demonstrated Projects - Self-built AI projects or agents you can showcase, covering both standard and custom workflow-specific use cases. Projects built with Claude (Cowork, Claude Code, Connectors, Skills, Plugins) are particularly valued.
Prompt Engineering - Ability to structure prompts effectively - framing tasks clearly, refining outputs, and adapting instructions to get consistent, high-quality results across different AI models.
Build Deploy - Experience taking an AI tool or agent from build to production; packaging (Docker), hosting, and monitoring in a real environment.
Technical Skills - Python for scripting, API calls, and data pre-processing; SQL for querying structured data; React for simple internal dashboards; AI coding tools such as Claude Code or ChatGPT Codex.
Communication Collaboration - Good communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and explain technical work clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Qualifications
Bachelor or Master degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, or any other relevant specialization (e.g., AI/ML, Data Science, IT).
Experience
1+ years of relevant experience in AI/ML engineering, software development, or applied AI projects.
You should be able to clearly demonstrate how you have used AI tools - including Claude - to build, deploy, and improve efficiency, quality, or speed in a professional context.
Job Type
Full time
Location
Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

Job Description

We are looking for a hands-on, consultative AI Lead to sit at the front line of client engagements and turn AI ambition into working software. You will run discovery with clients, shape priority use cases into buildable solutions, and then personally build the prototypes, agents, and phase-0 MVPs that create client conviction and accelerate deal conversion.

This is a forward deployed role: you work shoulder-to-shoulder with clients and the account team rather than behind a delivery firewall. Success is measured by how quickly a vague business problem becomes a demonstrable AI capability with a credible value hypothesis.

It sits at the intersection of AI engineering, solution design, and business value — and is best suited to a strong builder who is comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving sales cycles and enjoys being the technical voice in the room.

Roles & Responsibilities

Discovery and use-case shaping
Run early-stage discovery sessions and working groups with clients and account teams.
Identify pain points, value levers, and high-impact AI opportunities across the client's process landscape.
Translate vague or complex client questions into clear solution hypotheses, initial architectural logic, and a prioritised use-case backlog.
Build AI scenarios and "before/after" narratives that illustrate meaningful business transformation, with measurable outcomes attached.
Build and prove
Design AI solutions end to end for a given use case — LLM choice, prompt and context design, data sources, retrieval, tools, integrations, and a usable front end — working with the AI Architect on platform-level decisions.
Build prototypes, storyboards, demos, accelerators, and reusable agentic blueprints at pursuit speed.
Engineer and validate AI agents for reliability, reasoning quality, safety, and performance; stand up evaluation harnesses so claims are evidence-backed rather than anecdotal.
Lead PoCs, pilots, and phase-0 MVPs across industries, owning scope, timeline, and the technical outcome.
Client-facing content and conviction
Create client-ready material: solution and architecture decks, demo storylines, value frameworks, effort estimates, and inputs into proposals and SoWs.
Lead technical walkthroughs, deep-dives, and competitive differentiation discussions with client engineering and business stakeholders.
Refine solution narratives based on client feedback, objections, and market conditions.
Continuity and uplift
Own a clean handover from pursuit to delivery — architecture intent, code, decisions, risks, and open questions documented and transferred.
Contribute reusable assets back to the practice: accelerators, agent patterns, eval suites, reference implementations.
Mentor 2–5 engineers on agentic engineering practice and raise the bar on prototype quality.
 Must-have skills and experience

Agentic AI engineering

Hands-on working knowledge of defining and configuring prompts, instructions, tools, reasoning strategies, guardrails, memory, and orchestration in AI agent development.
Practical experience with multi-step and multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, and failure handling (retries, fallbacks, human-in-the-loop).

RAG and context engineering

Strong experience with RAG pipelines: chunking and indexing strategy, embeddings, vector databases, hybrid and re-ranked retrieval, evaluation of retrieval quality.
Working understanding of tokenization, context-window management, and cost/latency trade-offs.

Engineering craft

Hands-on experience creating and maintaining Python libraries; working command of LangChain (or equivalent orchestration frameworks), Hugging Face, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and locally hosted open models.
Very strong experience developing RESTful APIs in Python with FastAPI (or similar) and integrating third-party services, UI components, and APIs.
Hands-on Docker-based deployment and disciplined use of Git/GitHub for source control, branching, and review — mandatory.
Enough front-end capability (React/Streamlit/Gradio or equivalent) to make a demo feel like a product.

Model provider and hyperscaler GenAI platform know-how

Working familiarity across the major frontier-model providers and hyperscaler AI platforms, with genuine in-depth, hands-on depth in at least one of the following:
Anthropic — Claude model family, Claude API, tool use, extended thinking, Claude Agent SDK, MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool and data connectivity, Claude on Amazon Bedrock / Vertex AI.
OpenAI — GPT model family, Responses/Assistants APIs, Agents SDK, function calling, structured outputs, fine-tuning and batch APIs.
AWS — Amazon Bedrock (multi-model access, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Agents/AgentCore), SageMaker, and the surrounding data and security services.
Google — Gemini model family, Vertex AI (Model Garden, grounding, agent tooling), and Gemini enterprise offerings.
Microsoft Azure — Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, AI Agent Service, AI Search for retrieval, and Azure-native integration patterns.
Able to explain why a given provider or platform fits a client's constraints — model capability, context window, latency, cost per interaction, data residency and privacy posture, enterprise controls, existing cloud commitments — rather than defaulting to a personal favourite.
Comfortable building the same use case on more than one stack, and keeping solutions reasonably provider-portable so a client is not architecturally locked in by a prototype.

Consultative ability

Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business problems into crisp AI use cases with clear value hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
Strong communication and articulation skills; able to hold a technical room and a business room in the same meeting.
Hands-on prototyping mindset — able to quickly build functional demos, agent workflows, and LLM-powered interactions that accelerate client conviction.

 

Good to have
Prior pre-sales, consulting, or forward-deployed engineering exposure.
Depth in one or two industry domains (e.g. BFSI, healthcare/life sciences, retail, manufacturing, telecom).
Certification on a hyperscaler AI/ML track (AWS, Azure or Google), or equivalent demonstrable platform depth.
Familiarity with modern data platforms and their GenAI surfaces (Databricks, Snowflake Cortex, lakehouse patterns).
Experience with self-hosted / open-weight model deployment (vLLM, Ollama, Bedrock or Vertex custom endpoints) for clients with strict data-boundary requirements.
Exposure to LLM observability and evaluation tooling, and to responsible-AI and data-privacy considerations in regulated environments.
